gray.

a minimal agent harness. one binary. your machine, your keys.

Install — Linux / WSL / macOS*

curl -fsSL https://gray.alignment.id/install.sh | sh

Install — Windows (PowerShell)

iwr https://gray.alignment.id/install.ps1 -UseBasicParsing | iex

*macOS build coming soon — build from source in the meantime.

Run

export GRAY_API_KEY=sk-or-...        # openrouter.ai · deepseek.com · any OpenAI-compatible
export GRAY_MODEL=deepseek/deepseek-chat
gray                                  # interactive REPL
gray --print "explain this repo"      # one-shot

What it is

loopReAct tool loop — streams, calls tools, feeds results back
toolsbash · read · write · edit
sessionsJSONL on your disk, resume-ready
sizeone 6.5 MB binary · no runtime · no node_modules
promptidentity + engineering conventions, ~700 tokens total
